battle.name: 第二次萊希菲爾德之戰 (955)
battle.theater: 萊希河原野與奧格斯堡城郊
battle.brief: 955年8月10日，匈牙利馬格爾聯盟大軍南下，兵臨奧格斯堡；奧托一世調集薩克森、萊茵與巴伐利亞諸軍列陣萊希河原野，以密集盾步兵頂住輕騎，待其潰退再以騎兵追入濕地，迫其求和納貢，終結西征之患。卡面羅馬扭力弩砲未現身此役，卻是十世紀歐洲攻城砲的工藝祖先，其血統沿多瑙河要塞延續。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 955年8月萊希菲爾德之戰的交戰雙方，一邊是德意志王國的奧托王朝聯軍，一邊是匈牙利平原上的馬格爾部落聯盟。德方的框架是：奧托一世自936年2月2日加冕為德意志人的國王，952年兼領薩克森公爵，父岳父康拉德一世於954年8月23日暴卒後接掌施瓦本公爵位，並以國王身分兼負巴伐利亞的防務。聯軍由三部分拼成：薩克森與圖林根的王室直屬兵、萊茵與法蘭克系的諸侯與主教軍、以及巴伐利亞本地各領主召集的民兵與小武裝。教會方面的組織者是美因茨大主教弗里德里希，另有馬格德堡主教維希曼第二、奧格斯堡主教烏爾里希等人。制度上這不是常備軍，而是以王命臨時徵發的封建軍隊，裝備與戰力參差，卻在中歐第一次結合成足以正面迎擊遊牧騎兵的聯軍。匈牙利方面並非統一王國，而是卡爾、古爾、金等馬格爾部族組成的聯盟，首領名號在匈牙利編年史中常以「公子」（kun）加私名的方式出現；他們沒有固定城池與國土，只有冬季營地與廣闊牧場，國家機器極簡，靠輕騎掠奪維生，卻因此能年年入寇而無所顧忌。
countriesEn: The two sides at the battle of Lechfeld in August 955 were, on the one hand, the coalition of the Ottonian dynasty in the German kingdom, and on the other, the Magyar tribal confederation of the Hungarian plain. The German framework was as follows. Otto I was crowned King of the Germans on 2 February 936, took the duchy of Saxony in 952, and after his father-in-law Conrad I died suddenly on 23 August 954 he assumed the duchy of Swabia as well and, as king, took responsibility for the defence of Bavaria. The coalition was assembled from three parts: the royal household troops of Saxony and Thuringia, the contingents of the princes and bishops of the Rhine and the Franconian lands, and the levies and small war bands raised in Bavaria itself by the various counts and lords. On the ecclesiastical side the organiser was Frederick, Archbishop of Mainz, with Wichmann II, Bishop of Magdeburg, and Ulrich, Bishop of Augsburg, among the rest. In institutional terms this was not a standing army but a feudal force levied on the king's command; its equipment and its fighting quality were uneven, and yet it was the first time in central Europe that a coalition had been assembled strong enough to meet nomadic cavalry head on. The Hungarian side was not a unified kingdom at all but a confederation of Magyar kindreds such as the Karal, the Gyula and the Kendi, whose leaders appear in the Hungarian chronicles usually with the title kun followed by a personal name. They had no fixed towns and no territory, only winter camps and wide pastures; their state machinery was minimal, they lived by light cavalry plunder, and that is precisely why they could raid year after year without restraint.
people: 奧托一世（912年至973年），後世稱「奧托大帝」，是捕鳥者亨利之子，936年由大主教弗里德里希加冕為王，954年父岳父康拉德一世暴卒後兼領施瓦本公爵，955年8月親率聯軍在萊希菲爾德迎擊馬格爾人，962年2月2日在羅馬由教宗若望十二世加冕為皇帝。此役中最要緊的不是他擊敗了誰，而是他沒有讓全軍追擊潰兵：縱騎兵追殺落水者，也不許中軍離開陣位，寧可放過眼前的獵物，也要保住聯軍的陣形。康拉德一世（?-954年8月23日）是施瓦本與巴伐利亞的實際守護人，943至944年匈牙利人圍攻雷根斯堡時，是他集結巴伐利亞諸軍解了城圍；匈牙利編年史《匈牙利人的事蹟》記載，一名匈牙利女子被送入宮中行刺，卻先替他醫病，後受責備才下毒害死他——此說未必可信，卻說明當時人如何理解戰爭前夜吞城的恐懼。大主教弗里德里希（?-958年）替奧托經營教會與諸侯的關係，是聯軍得以成形的政治樞紐；馬格德堡主教維希曼第二是奧托的妻兄；奧格斯堡主教烏爾里希（923年至973年）自923年起坐鎮該城，955年8月全城正靠他與守軍撐到援軍到來。匈牙利方面的統帥，編年史多記為布爾丘（Bulcsú），部分後世記述另加萊爾（Lél）之名；同時代的德意志編年史維杜金德與雷吉諾只寫「匈牙利人」而不書首領姓名。
peopleEn: Otto I (912-973), later called Otto the Great, was the son of Henry the Fowler and was crowned king by Archbishop Frederick in 936; after his father-in-law Conrad I died suddenly in 954 he also took the duchy of Swabia, and in August 955 he led the coalition against the Magyars at Lechfeld, and on 2 February 962 he was crowned emperor in Rome by Pope John XII. The decisive thing about him in this battle was not that he beat an enemy, but that he did not let the whole army chase the fugitives: he let the cavalry kill men in the water and still forbade the centre to leave its position, preferring to let the quarry in front of him go in order to keep the formation of the coalition intact. Conrad I (?-23 August 954) was the real guardian of Swabia and Bavaria, and it was he who gathered the Bavarian contingents and lifted the siege of Regensburg when the Magyars besieged it in 943 and 944. The Hungarian chronicle known as the Gesta Hungarorum records that a Hungarian girl was brought into the palace to poison him, that she healed him instead, and that only later, reproached for it, she did poison him; the story may not be true, but it shows how contemporaries understood the terror of a city about to be swallowed in the night before the war. Frederick, Archbishop of Mainz (?-958), managed the Church and the princes for Otto and was the political hinge on which the coalition turned; Wichmann II, Bishop of Magdeburg, was Otto's brother-in-law; and Ulrich, Bishop of Augsburg (923-973), had held that see since 923 and was the man keeping the city alive in August 955 until the relieving host came. On the Hungarian side the commanders are named in the chronicles mostly as Bulcsú, with some later accounts adding the name of Lél; the contemporary German chroniclers, Widukind and Regino, write only of the Magyars and give no names for their leaders.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬弩砲（scorpio）是扭力弩機：靠絞盤把弩臂拉緊、鋼弦蓄力，一次射出方鏃鋼矢，有效射程約四百至六百步，既可平射遠處人馬，也可在攻城時壓制城頭射手；羅馬人用它在第二次馬其頓戰役前後拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了城邦體系。但955年的萊希菲爾德原野上沒有羅馬人，卡面此件兵器在此役的位置，是「工藝血統上的祖先」。它的技術在西方隨西羅馬覆亡而中斷，直到中世紀早期才以別的名義回到歐洲：拜占庭的螺式與配重式弩砲、伊斯蘭世界的弓弩與投石機、以及十二世紀重新出現的配重式投石機，都是同一條線的不同分支。955年前後德軍實際裝備的是野戰與守城用的弩砲（balista，即以絞盤蓄力的大型弩機）與牽引式投石機（mangonel），並非卡面此器的複製品，卻同屬一個技術家族。真正出現在萊希菲爾德原野上的，是雙方步兵與騎兵的常規裝備：德方以薩克森式大圓盾、鐵環甲與札甲、長柄矛（仍保留薩克森戰斧的傳統）、雙刃直劍與騎士用長劍為主，重裝步兵以密集縱隊結陣；匈牙利馬格爾人則是當時世上最銳利的輕騎射擊力量，以複合反曲弓、重箭、彎刀、小圓盾與皮革護具上馬，不穿重甲，撤退時在馬背上回射，戰術核心是不接戰即離開的擾亂與掠奪。攻城與守城的其餘要件同樣重要：壕溝、拒馬、木寨、隨軍攻城車，以及多瑙河沿岸要塞常備的弩砲與投石機。
kitsEn: The piece on the card, the Roman scorpio, is a torsion engine: a windlass draws the bow arms back, the steel bowstrings store the force, and the machine throws a single square-headed bolt, with a useful range of about four hundred to six hundred paces. It could shoot flat at distant men and horses and could also silence the archers on a wall during a siege; the Romans used it to pull down the walls of Greek cities in the years around the Second Macedonian War, and with it they pulled down the system of the Greek city-state as well. But there were no Romans on the plain of Lechfeld in 955, and the position of the piece on the card in this battle is that of an ancestor in the craft lineage. Its technology was interrupted in the West with the fall of the Roman empire and only returned to Europe in the early Middle Ages under other names: the helical and counterweight bolt-throwers of Byzantium, the bow-throwers and stone throwers of the Islamic world, and the counterweight trebuchet that reappeared in the twelfth century are all different branches of the same line. What the German armies actually had around 955 were the bolt-thrower used in the field and on the wall, the balista, that is a large winch-powered crossbow, and the traction trebuchet, the mangonel; these are not copies of the machine on the card but belong to the same family of technology. What actually stood on the plain of Lechfeld was the ordinary equipment of infantry and cavalry on both sides. The Germans fought with the great Saxon round shield, mail and lamellar armour, long spears, while keeping the old Saxon tradition of the axe, the straight double-edged sword and the knight's long sword, and their heavy infantry closed up in dense columns. The Magyar horse-archers were the sharpest light shooting force in the world at that time, riding with composite recurved bows, heavy arrows, sabres, small round shields and leather protection, wearing no heavy armour, and shooting back from the saddle as they withdrew; the core of their tactics was the harassment and the plunder that avoided contact. The rest of the siege and defence kit mattered as well: the ditch, the abatis, the wooden palisade, the siege wagons that marched with the army, and the bolt-throwers and stone throwers kept in the fortresses along the Danube.
tactics: 萊希菲爾德的打法是一場典型的十世紀中歐會戰。德軍聯軍在萊希河與奧格斯堡之間的空地上列陣，奧托把最能承受衝撞的薩克森重裝步兵與王室直屬隊放在最前，結成緊密橫列，圓盾互相遮蔽，長矛越過盾緣朝前；兩翼是萊茵與法蘭克系的騎兵與步騎混合隊，攜帶長矛、彎刀與標槍。匈牙利馬格爾人照例不願列陣硬撞，而是以輕騎在軍陣周邊反覆掠擾、試探缺口，待聯軍出動追擊才拔營北撤。德軍的計畫正是要誘使對方如此：奧托嚴令中軍不得離位，只放騎兵追擊，於是馬格爾騎兵在潰退中被逐入萊希河與低窪的濕地水草地，馬陷泥中，騎士與坐騎大量被殺被擒，步兵與弓手被分割追殺，戰局在數個時辰內崩解。戰後奧托沒有停在奧格斯堡城郊，而是率主力越過邊境深入馬格爾人的牧場地帶，燒毀聚落與冬營，切斷其秋季南下的通道，迫使對方在冬季到來前求和。整場戰役的補給邏輯也與此相關：德軍的糧秣靠後方鄉村與河谷供給，馬格爾人則是自成體系的遊牧經濟，只帶數日口糧上路，兩者在持久戰上的優劣由此決定。
tacticsEn: The fighting at Lechfeld was a typical central European meeting of armies in the tenth century. The German coalition deployed on the ground between the Lech and Augsburg, with Otto placing the Saxons and his own household troops, the men best able to absorb a charge, in front, drawn up in tight lines whose round shields covered one another and whose long spears reached out beyond the shield rims; on the wings stood the cavalry and the mixed horse-and-foot detachments of the Rhine and Franconia, carrying lances, sabres and javelins. The Magyars, as usual, had no wish to stand and be beaten in a straight line: their light horse worked round the edges of the formation, probing for gaps, and only broke off to the north when the coalition advanced to chase them. That was exactly what the German plan wanted. Otto strictly forbade the centre to leave its position and released only the cavalry to pursue, so the Magyar horse were driven into the marshy ground and the low water meadows of the Lech, where horses foundered in the mud and riders and mounts were killed or taken in large numbers, while foot and bowmen were cut off and hunted down; the battle collapsed within a few hours. After the fight Otto did not stop at the gates of Augsburg but took the main body across the frontier into the Magyar pasture country, burning their villages and winter camps and cutting off the route by which they meant to descend in the autumn, forcing them to sue for peace before winter arrived. The logistics of the campaign ran on the same logic: the German army drew its grain and supplies from the villages and river valleys behind it, whereas the Magyars, with a pastoral economy that carried itself, took only a few days of rations on the road, and that difference decided who could afford a long contest.
data: 可核對的數字與日期如下：奧托於936年2月2日加冕為王，952年兼領薩克森公爵，954年8月23日康拉德一世暴卒，955年8月10日萊希菲爾德交戰，962年2月2日在羅馬加冕為皇帝。匈牙利人此前的行動有清楚的年表：907年焚英戈爾施塔特並第一次深入巴伐利亞，943至944年大軍圍攻雷根斯堡、由康拉德解圍，948年與950年兩度掠奪慕尼黑，954年再把慕尼黑燒成焦土，隨即兵臨奧格斯堡與雷根斯堡，955年8月才有萊希菲爾德之戰。兵力方面沒有可靠數字：德意志編年史維杜金德只說奧托從薩克森、圖林根、萊茵與巴伐利亞聚集了一支大軍，匈牙利編年史則稱德軍數萬，顯係誇大；史家估算德軍實際規模在數千至一萬餘之間，匈牙利方面亦無可信記載。損失同樣不可考，只能確定匈牙利騎兵在濕地追擊中損失慘重，兩軍相加的具體數目在各種抄本中互相矛盾。羅馬弩砲的規格有古代文獻可依：扭力弩砲以銅管或木製弩臂配絞盤蓄力，鋼矢重約一公斤，射程約四百至六百步，操作需十數人，一具可連續射出；十世紀德意志的弩砲（balista）體積更小，用於守城與野戰堡壘，配備數十人。匈牙利編年史另記載955年後數年之內，匈牙利方面每年向德方支付賠款，具體年限與金額在各家抄本中互有出入。
dataEn: The numbers and dates that can be checked are these. Otto was crowned king on 2 February 936, took the duchy of Saxony in 952, Conrad I died suddenly on 23 August 954, the battle of Lechfeld was fought on 10 August 955, and Otto was crowned emperor in Rome on 2 February 962. The earlier actions of the Magyars run in a clear chronology: in 907 they burned Ingolstadt and pushed deep into Bavaria for the first time; in 943 and 944 they besieged Regensburg and were lifted by Conrad; in 948 and again in 950 they plundered Munich; in 954 they burned Munich to the ground and stood before Augsburg and Regensburg, and only in August 955 did Lechfeld follow. On the size of the armies there is no reliable figure: Widukind says only that Otto gathered a great host from Saxony, Thuringia, the Rhine and Bavaria, while the Hungarian chronicles speak of tens of thousands, which is plainly rhetorical; historians usually estimate the German force at several thousand to somewhere above ten thousand, and no trustworthy count exists for the Magyars. Losses are equally beyond reach, though it is certain that the Magyar horse lost heavily in the pursuit in the marsh, and the totals given in the various copies contradict one another. For the Roman engine itself the ancient literature gives the figures: the torsion bolt-thrower is charged by a winch acting on bronze tubes or wooden arms, its steel bolt weighs about a kilogramme, its range is about four hundred to six hundred paces, it needs a dozen men to work and can fire repeatedly. The German bolt-throwers of the tenth century were smaller, used in the defence of towns and in field fortifications, and worked by several dozen men. The Hungarian chronicles add that for a number of years after 955 Hungary paid annual compensation to the Germans, though the number of years and the amounts differ from copy to copy.
cause: 955年這場仗的直接起因是匈牙利人再度南侵，而巴伐利亞失去了主持防務的人。康拉德一世在943至944年曾成功解開雷根斯堡之圍，把匈牙利人擋在萊希河上游之外，卻在954年8月23日突然死去——死因在當時並無定論，後世史家或推測為急病，匈牙利編年史則渲染成中毒。康拉德一死，施瓦本與巴伐利亞出現權力真空：奧托雖在數月內接掌施瓦本，但對薩克森以外的諸侯只有號召力而無直接管轄，巴伐利亞貴族各自為政，守軍名冊與稅收體系都沒有統一起來。匈牙利人看準了這個空檔：954年焚慕尼黑，955年夏天大軍直抵奧格斯堡，開始考慮冬季駐紮整個內陸。更深一層的原因在於奧托的整體戰略：936年以來他一直在把王權從薩克森推向帝國，939年平定法蘭克的叛亂，952年在奧格斯堡召集諸侯、要求各地公爵與邊區侯爵效忠，955年的反匈牙利戰役正是這套政策的一部分——保衛巴伐利亞既是為王室的威信，也是為了讓德意志諸侯看到，有事時必須站在國王這一邊。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the fighting in 955 was a new Hungarian invasion into Bavaria at a moment when Bavaria had lost the man who had been holding its defence. Conrad I had lifted the siege of Regensburg in 943 and 944 and kept the Magyars above the Lech, and then died suddenly on 23 August 954, with no certain diagnosis: later historians propose a stroke or a seizure, while the Hungarian chronicles make much of a poisoning. When Conrad died there was a vacuum in the duchies of Swabia and Bavaria. Otto took over Swabia within months, but outside his own Saxony he had claims to obedience rather than command, the Bavarian nobles went their own ways, and neither the muster rolls nor the fiscal system of the province were unified under anyone. The Magyars saw the opening: they burned Munich in 954, and in the summer of 955 their great host stood before Augsburg and began to think of wintering in the interior. Deeper down, the cause lay in Otto's general policy. From 936 onward he had been pushing kingship out of Saxony towards an empire: he had put down the Frankish revolt of 939, he had summoned the princes at Augsburg in 952 and required the dukes and the margraves to do homage, and the campaign against the Hungarians in 955 was part of that policy. To defend Bavaria was at once a matter of the prestige of the crown and a way of showing the German princes that in a crisis they had to stand on the king's side.
impact: 萊希菲爾德之戰結束了匈牙利人對德意志的西征，也改變了兩條邊界的走向。對中歐而言，此役之後巴伐利亞獲得數十年相對安寧，奧格斯堡與雷根斯堡不再是年年告急的前線；955年之後奧托把多瑙河上游的邊區交給邊區侯爵，築堡、屯田、分段巡守，由此形成的要塞群把匈牙利人與德意志人之間的界線從一條模糊的牧場線變成一道有牆有壕的實體線，日後匈牙利王國向巴爾幹而非向西方擴張，起點正是這條被釘住的多瑙河邊界。對奧托本人而言，這場勝利是他從「薩克森人的國王」變成「德意志人的皇帝」的關鍵一步：955年之後的數年裡他在雷根斯堡召集諸侯會議，整頓帝國的司法與軍令，逐步削弱地方公爵的獨立權力，962年2月2日在羅馬由教宗若望十二世加冕為皇帝，帝國的概念由此成形。匈牙利人則在西線受阻後轉向南方，997與999年的東南歐征伐最終折於拜占庭的邊境，同樣是扭力與配重砲術在東方的延伸。兵器史上的位置更值得留意：卡面這具羅馬弩砲象徵的技術——用金屬強度換取射程與破壞力——在955年並不體現在萊希菲爾德的野戰中，卻已經決定了多瑙河沿岸要塞的樣貌：羅馬人用它拆城牆，中世紀的人用同族的弩砲守城牆。
impactEn: The battle of Lechfeld ended the westward incursions of the Magyars into Germany and changed the direction of two frontiers. For central Europe the fighting left Bavaria with decades of relative quiet, and Augsburg and Regensburg were no longer a frontier in yearly alarm; after 955 Otto put the defence of the upper Danube in the hands of the margraves, with castles, settled land and a system of rotating watches, and the chain of fortresses that grew out of this turned a vague line of pasture into a frontier with walls and ditches. Hungary, blocked in the west, turned to the south instead, and the campaigns of 997 and 999 into the south-east finally came to grief on the Byzantine frontier, in the same tradition of torsion and counterweight artillery carried east. For Otto himself this victory was the step from king of the Saxons to emperor of the Germans. In the years after 955 he held the assemblies of the princes at Regensburg, put the empire's justice and military order back in hand and reduced the independence of the territorial dukes one by one; on 2 February 962 he was crowned emperor in Rome by Pope John XII, and the idea of an empire was thereby formed. The place of the weapon in the history of arms deserves particular notice: the technology the card stands for, trading metal strength for range and destructive power, did not decide the open field at Lechfeld, but it had already decided the shape of the fortresses along the Danube, for the Romans used it to break walls and the people of the Middle Ages used a member of the same family to defend them.
result: 8月10日的午後，馬格爾人全線崩潰；騎兵被殺被俘以萬計的說法雖不可信，慘敗的程度卻無疑。匈牙利人放棄圍困奧格斯堡，帶著殘餘向北退卻，聯軍沒有深入追擊，而是留在原地重整。奧托隨後把戰場的殘局變成政治成果：他沒有解散聯軍，而是帶著聯軍越過邊境進入馬格爾人的地界，燒掉他們準備過冬的聚落與草場，使對方在冬季到來前無處可去。匈牙利方面不得不派出使者求和，同意歸還擄掠之物並連年支付賠款；德意志編年史記載雙方在955至956年之間達成協議，從956年起匈牙利人停止對巴伐利亞的襲擊，慕尼黑與雷根斯堡再未陷落，奧格斯堡也在此後數十年成為南德重要的教會與市集中心。對匈牙利人而言，這不是國家的覆亡，而是聯盟的第一次重挫：三個主要部族之間的勢力被重新洗牌，統一於一人的王國觀念在隨後數十年中慢慢成形，匈牙利從此轉向巴爾幹。戰爭的直接結果是一場慘敗與一份不平等的和平，直接的後果則是奧托一世的帝國路線獲得第一個可靠的里程碑；而在兵器史的長線上，此役的真正位置，是在一個即將把配重式投石機重新裝上攻城車的中歐世界中，把羅馬式扭力砲術的血統守在多瑙河的要塞之中。
resultEn: In the afternoon of the tenth day the Magyar line came apart everywhere, and although the claim that tens of thousands of horse were killed or taken is not credible, the completeness of the defeat is not in doubt. The Hungarians gave up the siege of Augsburg and withdrew north with what was left of them, and the coalition did not pursue them into the interior but stayed in place to reform. Otto then turned the wreckage of the battlefield into a political result: he did not disband the coalition but took it across the frontier into Magyar territory, burned the settlements and pastures they meant to winter in, and left the enemy nowhere to go when winter came. The Hungarian side had to send envoys to sue for peace, agreeing to give back what had been taken and to pay compensation year by year. The German chronicles record that a settlement was reached between 955 and 956; from 956 the Magyars stopped raiding Bavaria, Munich and Regensburg were never taken again, and Augsburg became a major centre of church and market in the south of Germany for the decades to come. For the Hungarians this was not the ruin of a state but the first serious blow to the confederation: the balance of power among the three main kindreds was rearranged, the idea of a single kingship formed slowly in the following decades, and Hungary turned towards the Balkans. The immediate result was a severe defeat and an unequal peace; the lasting consequence was that the imperial line of Otto I acquired its first reliable milestone. On the long run of the history of arms, the real place of this battle is that it stood at the moment when a central Europe was about to put counterweight trebuchets back onto their siege wagons, and it kept the Roman art of torsion artillery alive in the fortresses of the Danube.
